options.content: Repos mit einem ungewöhnlich starken Star/Fork-Anstieg in den letzten **${hours}h**, bewertet nach statistischer Signifikanz. Das **sig_score**-Modell basiert auf Poisson: Wie unwahrscheinlich ist dieser Anstieg gegeben der normalen Rate des Repos? Score ≥ 3 ≈ 95 % Konfidenz, dass der Anstieg nicht zufällig ist. **alpha=${alpha}** gewichtet Stars, **beta=${beta}** Forks. Drill-Down: → Repos · Users · Orgs

targets.rawSql:
WITH
  config AS ( 
    SELECT
      date_trunc('minute', NOW())::timestamp AS ts_now,  -- round to minute
      INTERVAL '${hours} hours' AS time_window,
      1000                AS top_n,
      5                   AS min_stars,
      1                   AS min_forks,
      ${alpha}::FLOAT        AS alpha,
      ${beta}::FLOAT         AS beta     
  ),
  
  repo_events AS (
    SELECT
        e.repo_id,
        sum(case when detail ='starred' then 1 else 0 end) as count_stars_interval,
        sum(case when detail like 'forked%' then 1 else 0 end) as count_forks_interval
    FROM events e, config cfg
      WHERE e.time >= cfg.ts_now - cfg.time_window
      GROUP BY e.repo_id
      ORDER BY count_stars_interval DESC, count_forks_interval DESC
      LIMIT (SELECT top_n FROM config)
  ),
  repo_baseline AS ( 
    SELECT 
        r.name,
        r.full_name,
        e.repo_id,
        r.created_at,
        sum(case when e.detail ='starred' then 1 else 0 end) AS count_stars_all,
        sum(case when e.detail like 'forked%' then 1 else 0 end) AS count_forks_all,
        r.forks_count AS init_forks,
        r.stargazers_count AS init_stars
    FROM events e
    JOIN repos r ON r.repo_id = e.repo_id
    WHERE e.repo_id IN (SELECT repo_id FROM repo_events)
    GROUP BY e.repo_id, r.forks_count, r.stargazers_count, r.name, r.full_name, r.created_at
  ),
 
repo_overview AS (
    SELECT
      re.repo_id,
      rb.name,
      rb.full_name,
      rb.created_at,
      re.count_stars_interval,
      re.count_forks_interval,
      (rb.count_stars_all + rb.init_stars) AS total_stars,
      -- Actual baseline BEFORE the window: total minus what happened in the window
      (rb.init_stars + rb.count_stars_all - re.count_stars_interval) AS baseline_stars,
      (rb.init_forks + rb.count_forks_all - re.count_forks_interval) AS baseline_forks,
      (rb.count_forks_all + rb.init_forks) AS total_forks,
      rb.count_forks_all AS count_forks_all,
      rb.count_stars_all AS count_stars_all,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (SELECT ts_now FROM config) - rb.created_at::timestamp) / 3600 AS repo_age_hours
    FROM repo_events re
    JOIN repo_baseline rb ON rb.repo_id = re.repo_id
    ORDER BY re.count_stars_interval DESC, re.count_forks_interval DESC
),

  hidden_gem_calc AS (
    SELECT 
      ro.repo_id,
      ro.name,
      ro.full_name,
      ro.count_stars_interval,
      ro.count_forks_interval,
      ro.baseline_stars,
      ro.baseline_forks,
      ro.total_stars,
      ro.total_forks,
      ro.repo_age_hours,
      calc_lambda(
          cfg.alpha, cfg.beta,
          ro.baseline_stars::INT, ro.baseline_forks::INT,
          ro.count_stars_interval::INT, ro.count_forks_interval::INT,
          GREATEST(ro.repo_age_hours::FLOAT, 1.0),  -- safety clamp
          cfg.time_window
      ) AS lambda
    FROM repo_overview ro, config cfg
  ),

  repo_hidden_gem_overview AS (
    SELECT 
      hc.repo_id,
      hc.name , 
      hc.full_name,
      hc.count_stars_interval,
      hc.count_forks_interval,
      hc.baseline_stars,
      hc.baseline_forks,
      hc.total_stars,
      hc.total_forks,
      hc.repo_age_hours,
      hc.lambda,
      scores.poisson_cdf,
      scores.sig_score
    FROM hidden_gem_calc hc, config cfg,
    LATERAL calc_rising_star_scores(
        numb_stars_forks        := (cfg.alpha * hc.count_stars_interval::FLOAT + cfg.beta * hc.count_forks_interval::FLOAT)::INT,
        lambda                  := hc.lambda,
        count_stars_in_interval := hc.count_stars_interval::INT,
        count_forks_in_interval := hc.count_forks_interval::INT,
        min_stars               := cfg.min_stars,
        min_forks               := cfg.min_forks
  ) AS scores     
  )
  


SELECT full_name AS repository_path, sig_score AS significance_score FROM repo_hidden_gem_overview ORDER BY sig_score DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

panels.description:
Poisson CDF — P(X < x_t): The probability that a repository receives fewer stars/forks than actually observed, given its normal rate. The closer to 1, the more unusual the surge.

Sig Score — -ln(1 - CDF): Log-transformed p-value. Measures how strongly the observed surge deviates from the expected rate. A score ≥ 3 corresponds to roughly 95% significance, meaning: "With 95% confidence, this surge is not due to chance."
